title: Claude Design + Codex = a literal cheat code #ai #chatgpt #claude #aihacks #aitips
description: Build AI sites and apps that look premium without the “AI slop” — and save money doing it. In this short, I show you a simple workflow using Cloud Design + Codex to turn a rough idea into a polished app fast. Want the free alternative? Comment “design” and I’ll share the setup.
transcript: This is the secret combo that's going to make any AI sites or apps you build look unbelievable. And it's also going to save you a ton of money. You also don't need to be some wizard prompt engineer to make this happen. So now you can build something for yourself or your clients that doesn't look like AI slop. Make sure to save this and stick around to the end cuz I got another secret that's going to allow you to take this even farther. Step one, head to Claude design, create a new high-fidelity project, and give it a name. Then just voice dictate what you're looking for, and don't worry about being overly technical. It's going to ask you some clarifying questions and come up with a beautiful design. You can make more edits if you want, but when you're ready, just click share and export HTML. Then you're going to head to Codex. Download it if you don't already have it. Codex is connected to your ChatGPT account, and you're going to get tons of usage out of the $20 plan. Then inside Codex, create a new project. In a new chat, add the HTML you downloaded from Claude design, paste the original prompt that you wrote into Claude design, and then just tell it you want to make this come to life. And then your design prototype will be a fully built app. So Claude design has pretty strict usage limits, but you can use something called open design to do the exact same thing for free. I put together a full video on how to set up open design. If you want it, just drop the word design in the comments below.
